description: Items obtained by deterministically solving secret notes (image-puzzle dig spots, mermaid show, junimo plush bush, etc). Hardcoded in Stardew source — these are deterministic puzzle rewards, not random drops. Hand-curated from https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Secret_Notes solution sections. The pipeline emits a `secret-note-reward` source row per item, referencing the note number. Rendered as a static label in the UI (notes are not first-class entities yet).

rewards.note: Interact with the bush above the playground at noon on day 28 of any season
Mermaid show at the Night Market — click shells in order 1-5-4-2-3
Dig the tile right of the boulder north of Railroad tracks
Dig the farthest north tile on the east side of the river north of JojaMart
Dig southwest of the bench in the southeast Calico Desert (not during Desert Festival)
